title: Background Click Deselects in Cad
description: When pressing/clicking in the CAD viewport background (empty space), selection should clear — same as marquee selection with no hits in default mode.
summary: Clicking the CAD viewport background (no pick hit) now clears selection in default modifier mode, matching marquee selection with zero hits. Shared clearSelectionOnEmptyBackgroundPick helper in canvas pointer-up handler; unit test for replMergeSelectionPickInView with empty pick.
